prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE original enemy battle-sprite illustration, industrial fantasy action RPG, M20 Rail-Gun Carriage from an abandoned underground hangar. A narrow elongated precision railgun barrel on a squat swiveling carriage permanently captive on a SHORT HORIZONTAL MECHANICAL SLIDE RAIL. The rail is an integral part of the enemy mechanism, only one compact lateral rail segment slightly wider than the carriage, not environmental railway tracks or a platform. Its key silhouette is a long thin forward cannon crossing a transverse guide rail into a restrained T shape. Clearly visible captive rollers, polished slide shoes, belt drive and closed end stops explain lateral sliding between two firing positions. No wheels for free movement, no legs, no humanoid parts, no surrounding scenery. Slightly offset carriage poised to shoot, small amber alignment lens on cannon and quiet copper coils, vulnerable exposed base. Mining salvage joined by subtle mineral-organic fibers, coal-black steel, worn ochre enamel, oxidized copper contacts and ivory ceramic insulators. Premium richly hand-painted stylized industrial-fantasy rendering, beautiful intentional engineering and broad clean light/shadow shapes, detail supports silhouette rather than noise. Elevated three-quarter camera looking down about 40 degrees. Complete mechanism including muzzle and both rail ends, centered with 12 percent transparent safety margin. Readable as a rail-mounted precision turret at 70 pixels. Solid near-opaque subject with genuinely transparent alpha outside contour; no background, floor, cast shadow, pedestal, smoke, glow halo, lettering, numbers, logos, UI, watermark or existing game design.

alpha_validation.notes: Original generated alpha preserved; broad subject is nearly opaque. Transparent pixels may retain RGB visible in alpha-ignoring viewers.

visual_inspection: Long precision barrel sits on a captive rail carriage.
Short lateral rail and visible end stops convey bounded movement.
Whole muzzle and rail ends visible; rail is part of enemy mechanism, not scenery.
production_status: Single battle-ready illustration. Full directional animation, attacks, recovery and 70-pixel in-engine visual QA remain separate deliverables.
